title: My Available Hours
subtitle: Define the time slots you are available for so students can request appointments.

state.empty: You have not defined any available slots yet.

draft.instruction: Click an empty cell in the calendar to start a new slot; click other cells on the same day to extend it.

hint.past: You cannot add a slot in the past.
hint.occupied: The selection overlaps an existing slot.
hint.tooLong: A slot can be at most {{hours}} hours long.
hint.tooFarAhead: Slots can be added at most {{days}} days ahead.
hint.crossesDayBoundary: A slot cannot run across {{time}}; add the parts before and after {{time}} as two separate slots.

actions.lockedHint: A slot with an appointment cannot be deleted

messages.loadFailed: Availability slots could not be loaded.
messages.addFailed: The slot could not be added.
messages.deleteFailed: The slot could not be deleted.
